sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Avtoskop (avtoskop.com.ua) is an online service where buyers describe the car they want and sellers send them offers. The service is provided by {operator}. Contact: {email}. The service is free for buyers. For sellers it is free until 1 April 2027; after that a fee applies only for buyers who chose to share their number with the seller, and we will announce the amount at least 30 days ahead.

sections.title: 2. Who can use it
sections.body: You must be 18 or older. Sign-in and phone confirmation work through Telegram, so you need a Telegram account.

sections.title: 3. Our role
sections.body: We only connect buyers and sellers. We don't sell cars, aren't a party to any deal, don't take payment for cars, and don't guarantee a car's condition, price or a seller's honesty. All agreements and payments are between buyer and seller.

sections.title: 4. For buyers
sections.body: A request is published after you share your number in Telegram. Everyone visiting the site can see published requests, and we may share them on social networks to find sellers. Your number is never published. Don't put your name, address or other personal details in the request comment; we hide phones, links and usernames automatically. You decide which sellers get your number, and this can't be undone. Don't pay a deposit before you have seen the car and documents and signed a contract.

sections.title: 5. For sellers
sections.body: An offer must be about a real car you can sell or deliver. The price must be all-in, including delivery, customs and registration. Photos must show this very car; don't put phone numbers or links on them. You may not demand a deposit without a contract or send the same offer to every request. Once you receive a buyer's number, you are responsible for its use: only to contact the buyer about this deal, with no advertising and no passing it on.

sections.title: 6. Not allowed for anyone
sections.body: Fraud, false requests or offers, other people's phone numbers, spam, abuse, cars of illegal origin, or cars registered in russia or belarus.

sections.title: 7. Moderation
sections.body: We may review sellers, limit the number of offers, hide offers and block accounts that break these terms, including after buyer complaints. The "Verified seller" badge only means we reviewed the seller's profile and contacts; it doesn't guarantee a deal.

sections.title: 8. Reports
sections.body: To report fraud or illegal content, press "Report this offer" or write to {email}. We review reports within 7 days, and obvious fraud as soon as possible.

sections.title: 9. Liability
sections.body: The service is provided as is. We aren't liable for losses from deals between buyers and sellers, but we act on complaints and block offenders.

sections.title: 10. Law and disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by the law of Ukraine. If something goes wrong, write to {email} first and we will try to resolve it. If that fails, a Ukrainian court decides.

sections.title: 11. Changes
sections.body: We may change these terms. A new version applies from the update date on this page, and we announce important changes through the Telegram bot.

sections.title: 1. Who processes data
sections.body: Data is processed by {operator} under the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection". Contact about data: {email}. By accepting this policy when you post a request or sign in, you consent to the processing described here.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
sections.body: Buyers: the phone number you shared in Telegram, request details (car, budget, region, wishes, comment), site language, and Telegram ID after the number is confirmed. Sellers: Telegram ID, Telegram name and username, profile details (name, type, region, countries, description) and offers with their photos. The site uses only technical cookies for sign-in; there are no advertising cookies. We count page views without cookies or IP addresses, only as daily totals.

sections.title: 3. What others see
sections.body: A published request (car, years, budget, region, wishes and comment) is visible to everyone visiting the site, and we may share it on social networks. A buyer's phone number and Telegram account are never published. Buyers see a seller's profile (name, type, region, description) together with the offer. Offer photos are seen only by the buyer the offer was sent to and by the seller; they never appear on public pages.

sections.title: 4. How we protect numbers
sections.body: A buyer's number is stored only encrypted and shown only to sellers the buyer chose. We don't store sellers' numbers, only a protected fingerprint to prevent duplicate accounts. We remove hidden data from offer photos, including where they were taken.

sections.title: 5. Why
sections.body: To publish requests without contact details, deliver offers, notify you in Telegram about new requests and offers, prevent fraud and duplicates, and handle complaints.

sections.title: 6. Who we share with
sections.body: A buyer's number goes only to sellers the buyer chose. After that the seller is responsible for how the number is used, and we can't take it back. Sign-in and notifications work through Telegram, where Telegram's own privacy policy applies. Data is stored on servers in the EU. We don't sell data or share it with advertisers.

sections.title: 7. How long
sections.body: We keep data while a request or account is active, and as long as needed to handle complaints. Photos never sent with an offer are deleted after a day, and photos of offers on closed requests 90 days after closing. You can ask us to delete your data at any time by writing to {email}.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
sections.body: You can ask what data we hold, correct it, withdraw consent or ask us to delete it: write to {email}. We reply within 30 days.

buyerItems.a: It lets us confirm the number is really yours, with no SMS or passwords, and send you new offers. Sellers don't see your Telegram, and the bot only writes when something matters.
Nobody, until you press "Share my number" on an offer. Then only that seller gets it. We store the number encrypted.
Yes. Avtoskop is always free for buyers. For sellers it is free until 1 April 2027.

Once you confirm in Telegram, sellers can see the request, and those who work with your brand and region get an alert right away. Offers arrive in Telegram and on your private page. After 30 days the request closes unless you extend it.

We check companies against the state register and their contacts; then they get the "Verified seller" badge. New sellers can send only 5 offers a day. Scammers can be reported in one click, and we block them.
Don't pay a deposit before you've seen the car and documents and signed a contract. If the seller added a VIN, we show whether the car is on the police wanted list and whether the make matches.

sellerItems.q: How do I start sending offers?
sellerItems.a: Sign in with Telegram, fill in your profile and choose your brands and regions. The bot sends you new requests, and your account shows the requests that fit you.

sellerItems.q: How do I become a verified seller?
sellerItems.a: Fill in your profile with your company or sole-proprietor name and write to us with your company code (EDRPOU) or a link to your website or company page. We check the state register and usually add the badge the same day. Verified sellers can send up to 50 offers a day.

Free until 1 April 2027. After that you'll pay a small amount only for a buyer who chose to share their number with you. Getting requests and sending offers is always free. We'll announce the price at least 30 days ahead, and it won't apply to buyers who shared their number before that.

sellerItems.q: When do I get the buyer's number?
sellerItems.a: When the buyer presses "Share my number" on your offer. The number arrives in Telegram and appears in your account.

about.title: About Avtoskop
about.lead: A service where the buyer describes the car, and sellers come to them.
about.p1: Buying a car in Ukraine usually means hours of scrolling through listings, dozens of calls, and your number ending up with everyone. I wanted to turn that around: the buyer describes once what they want, sellers offer options, and nobody calls without your consent.
about.p2: Avtoskop is currently a pilot. I check sellers myself, read every report and answer messages. If something doesn't work, or you have an idea to make it better, write to me.
about.v1Text: Only the seller you choose sees it.
about.v2Text: We check companies and block scammers.
